Construiré un dashboard de signos vitales para misiones de larga duración (usando simulación de sensores, datos de la NASA OSDR/LSDA e IA predictiva).

Abierto a un diseñador UI/UX, apoyo en frontend o creador de contenido/storytelling para que el pitch e interfaz queden impecables. Cualquiera es bienvenido no importa tu edad o herramienta
summary: AURORA (Adaptive Understanding & Risk Observation for Astronauts) is a preventive biomedical telemetry and anomaly detection web platform designed to protect astronaut health during deep-space missions. Traditional monitoring systems rely on static vital sign thresholds that trigger false alarms during physical exercise or miss early physiological deterioration when readings appear nominal. AURORA builds an individualized baseline for each crew member using anthropometric BMI calibration and evaluates six parameters simultaneously—heart rate, body temperature, respiratory rate, oxygen saturation (SpO2), sleep duration, and physical activity—via a Scikit-learn IsolationForest model. By calculating explainable Z-score deviations, projecting 15-minute fatigue risks, and providing separate views for individual astronauts and flight surgeons, AURORA empowers autonomous crews to detect subtle health risks before medical emergencies occur.
details:
WHAT IT DOES & HOW IT WORKS

AURORA is a preventive health-intelligence platform built for long-duration space missions. Instead of checking whether vital signs cross rigid upper or lower limits, AURORA learns each astronaut's personal baseline and tracks multi-parameter drift across six indicators: Heart Rate, Body Temperature, Respiratory Rate, Oxygen Saturation (SpO2), Sleep Duration, and Physical Activity (Resting, Walking, Exercising).

KEY FEATURES & CREATIVITY

1. Dual-Role Mission Architecture: Astronauts log in with personal credentials, weight, and height for automatic BMI calculation and randomized circadian sleep profiling, viewing strictly their own private telemetry. Flight Surgeons/Doctors access a dedicated Supervisor View to monitor all registered crew members simultaneously.

2. Context-Aware Machine Learning: A Scikit-learn IsolationForest model paired with StandardScaler evaluates physiological readings alongside physical activity context, eliminating false positives during exercise while catching hidden cardiovascular strain caused by sleep deprivation.

3. Explainable Z-Scores & 15-Minute Projection: Every alert identifies the exact physiological driver using personal Z-scores, estimates fatigue risk over the next 15 minutes, offers an interactive AURORA Copilot for autonomous crew queries, and exports clinical CSV logs.

BENEFITS & INTENDED IMPACT

During deep-space missions (such as lunar or Mars transit) where Earth communication delays prevent real-time medical supervision, AURORA gives crews early, explainable warnings so they can adjust rest, hydration, or oxygen protocols before critical deterioration occurs.

TOOLS, LANGUAGES & SCIENTIFIC FACTORS CONSIDERED

- Languages & Frameworks: Python, Flask, HTML5, CSS3 (HTML5 Canvas for real-time trajectory charts).

- Machine Learning & Data: Scikit-learn (IsolationForest, StandardScaler), Pandas, NumPy, Joblib, and SQLite for historical persistence.

- Human Factors Considered: Individual anthropometric differences (BMI), circadian rhythm disruption, physical exertion context, and cognitive interpretability for non-medical crew members.

- Source Code Repository: https://github.com/erickzelaya23/AURORA-SpaceApps
